relationship_to_prior_work: Outcome-informed implementation follow-up. The production-method defect and scalar fixture were previously observed; an unpinned development run showed the intended Trainer path could execute. This protocol pins the runner and fixture before the retained replay.

candidate.get_batch_samples: Call Trainer.get_batch_samples, then sum batch['global_n_tokens'][0] across that accumulation window and return the sum as num_items_in_batch.
candidate.compute_loss: Use num_items_in_batch/world_size as the shared denominator for each microbatch; for calls without a window count, use global_n_tokens*current_gradient_accumulation_steps. Do not divide again by the accumulation count after using a window denominator.

estimand: The exact one-step parameter delta obtained by training on one full batch with accumulation_steps=1, compared with the same ordered token rows trained as microbatches within a single optimizer step.
primary_metrics: actual Trainer optimizer-step parameter delta absolute error against full-batch reference
acceptance_rule: Baseline must show >0.02 absolute parameter-delta error on the counterexample and zero error on the negative control. Candidate must match the full-batch reference within 1e-6 on all three fixtures, complete exactly one Trainer optimizer step per arm, receive window counts [10] for the full accumulation window and [1] for the short final window, and preserve direct-call fallback within 1e-7.
stopping_rule: Run only the frozen fixtures and one-step CPU updates. Do not train a pretrained model. A pass authorizes a separate two-rank CPU DDP/dispatcher protocol, not upstream submission or capability claims.
